_comment: Semantics: 'value' is the hard threshold (breaching it is a FAIL);
'warn' is a buffer sitting just short of 'value', so amber means 'close to breaching'.
direction=minimum -> good if actual >= warn, warn if actual >= value, else bad
direction=maximum -> good if actual <= warn, warn if actual <= value, else bad
Values are taken from real runs 339-359 so the gates are meaningful rather than
aspirational. Test coverage is deliberately not a gate: it is exactly 100 - skip_rate,
so gating both would double-count one signal. It remains a KPI tile.

pass_rate.name: Pass rate
pass_rate.recommendation: Investigate failing tests; a sustained dip below 98% usually means a real product or environment regression.

fail_rate.name: Fail rate
fail_rate.recommendation: Assertion failures point at product behaviour. Triage before they become accepted noise.

broken_rate.name: Broken rate
broken_rate.recommendation: Broken tests are infrastructure or setup errors, not product bugs. Check TeamCity startup and fixture cleanup.

skip_rate.name: Skip rate
skip_rate.recommendation: Around a quarter of the suite is currently disabled. Re-enable or delete skipped tests: a skipped test is untested code that still looks green.

flaky_rate.name: Flaky rate
flaky_rate.recommendation: Tests whose status flips across runs without a code change. Stabilise waits and test data isolation.

critical_failures.name: Critical failures
critical_failures.recommendation: Any failed or broken test in the latest run. Once @Severity annotations exist this narrows to blocker/critical only.

avg_duration_sec.name: Average test duration
avg_duration_sec.recommendation: Mean wall time per executed test. Look at the slowest-tests table before optimising anything else.

suite_duration_sec.name: Suite duration
suite_duration_sec.recommendation: End-to-end suite wall time, excluding CI setup and the agent-sync wait.

api_coverage.name: API coverage
api_coverage.recommendation: Share of spec operations touched by at least one request (full + partial). Add tests for the endpoints listed as empty.

conditions_coverage.name: Conditions coverage
conditions_coverage.recommendation: Share of swagger-coverage conditions met - status codes, parameters and body variants. The strictest coverage signal available.

full_coverage_rate.name: Fully covered operations
full_coverage_rate.recommendation: Operations where every declared condition is met. Currently zero: most endpoints are exercised only on the happy path.
